### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We will solve harder problems faster, test more ideas and unlock breakthroughs that would otherwise take generations.

2. We believe the impact of superintelligent AI will be clear and profound: if it is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery and transform what humanity can achieve.

3. Superintelligent AI will accelerate research across medicine, energy, climate science and beyond. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We should prepare for that transformation now.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

We hold a clear view of what lies ahead: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. Its ability to analyze evidence, generate hypotheses, design experiments and connect insights across disciplines will transform how quickly knowledge advances. We will see faster progress in medicine, energy, climate science, materials and every other field shaped by complex research. Discoveries that once required decades will arrive in years, and questions that have resisted generations of scientists will become solvable. This transformation will reshape our institutions, priorities and possibilities. We must begin preparing now for a world in which scientific progress moves twice as fast.
